exercises.question: Which sentence compares two learning methods? [¿Cuál compara dos métodos de aprendizaje?]
options: La práctica es más eficaz que memorizar listas. [Practice is more effective than memorising lists.]
La práctica es eficaz. [Practice is effective.]
La práctica será eficaz. [Practice will be effective.]

exercises.sentence: Este método es más __ que el anterior. [This method is more effective than the previous one.] (eficaz)

exercises.english: Practice is more effective than memorising lists.

sentences: Primero comparo los métodos. [First I compare the methods.]
